name: Terminal CRT
oneLiner: An amber phosphor terminal: 80-column discipline, monospace everything, and scanlines only where they do not touch text.
avoidFor: any form-heavy flow with many field types

effects.noise: subtle 3px scanline at 4% opacity on the page frame only
effects.glow: 0 0 6px rgba(255, 180, 84, 0.35) on the active prompt and live output only

motion.reducedMotion: no blinking cursor and no typing animation; render output at once

default.base: display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--uiux-color-text)
default.cursor: display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 16px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); animation: uiux-blink 1.1s steps(2, end) infinite

default.base: margin: 0; padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); border-left: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-border); color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.7; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere
padding: 16px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 0
default.header: display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding-bottom: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--uiux-color-border); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted)

default.base: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); color: var(--uiux-color-accent); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1

height: 36px; width: 100%; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-bg); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem
default.focus-visible: border-color: var(--uiux-color-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(255, 180, 84, 0.35); outline: none

do: Set everything in one monospace family; differentiate with weight, color, and position only.
Keep the content column between 64 and 80 characters so it still reads as a terminal.
Use a single phosphor hue for text and reserve green/red for run status.
Draw frames with 1px borders and dashed dividers rather than cards with shadows.
dont: Do not mix a sans-serif body into the terminal voice.
Do not put scanlines, glow, or CRT curvature behind body text.
Do not animate typing for content that users need to scan repeatedly.
Do not use more than two accent hues; this is a monochrome phosphor display.
antiPatterns: Green-on-black with 40px glow around every line, making text bloom and blur.
A terminal frame wrapped around a standard card dashboard with rounded corners.
Blinking cursor animation running on five elements at once.

notes: Amber on near-black exceeds 12:1, but glow blurs edges; keep glow off body copy.
Monospace at 13–14px needs generous line-height (1.7) for comfortable scanning.
Blinking cursors violate WCAG 2.2.2 if they blink faster than 0.5s; keep at 1.1s or allow disabling.
